title: Most World Cup games since 1994
brief: Name the ten players with the most World Cup finals appearances from 1994 to 2026.
period: World Cups 1994 to 2026. Games before 1994 don't count.

notes.Lothar Matthaus: Lothar Matthaus played 25 World Cup games, but most came in 1982, 1986 and 1990, so he is well short here.
notes.Paolo Maldini: Paolo Maldini played 23 World Cup games, but 7 came in 1990, so 16 count here.
notes.Diego Maradona: Diego Maradona played 21 World Cup games, almost all before 1994.

checks: All-time appearance totals agree between Transfermarkt and Opta Analyst's list (updated after the 2026 final) for every player on 20 or more; Wikipedia confirms Messi's 34. Pre-1994 games removed: Maldini 7 in 1990 (Opta's text: all seven of Italy's matches). Matthaus (25: two cameos in 1982 and every minute of 1990 per Opta, plus 1986) and Maradona (21, 1982 to 1994) fall well below 20 once pre-1994 games go; Seeler, Zmuda and Lato played only before 1994. Five players on 20 share the last place. Players at 19 come from Transfermarkt only.
